thread:
marie: Quick heads-up — pen test retest handoff. Need a 2-hr RBAC change window + KMS grant rotation and confirmation of log sampling before handover. Who owns evidence scrub & presigned upload? @josh @alex @samir

josh: I can own the RBAC window. Planning ephemeral role swap at 21:00 UTC. Need exact resource list (roles, groups, service principals). How long do assessor creds live? 1 hour?

marie: yes 1h max. We'll set a hard TTL in the runbook.

alex: For KMS — prefer creating a short-lived grant via KMS proxy scoped to the testing principal with TTL 1h. Avoid full key rotation.

samir: Agreed. Log-sampling plan: (1) run sampling query, (2) redact PII, (3) generate proof archive (hashed + timestamps). I'll handle redaction.

anna: I'll schedule retest slot: Tue 2026-04-07 21:00 UTC. I'll create presigned S3 link for evidence upload.

marie: Owners: RBAC = josh, KMS grant = alex, scrub = samir, presigned upload = anna, manifests = josh. Any blockers?

josh: Need infra approval to create ephemeral roles in prod namespace. pinging @infra-team

infra-team: approved. ✅ Recommend a short smoke test after role swap to validate gates.

samir: Draft scrub snippet (run on staging export):
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/api --start-time $START --end-time $END | jq '.events[] | {ts:.timestamp, msg:(.message | gsub("(?i)\\b(email|ssn|credit_card)\\b":"[REDACTED]"))}' > scrubbed.json
```

josh: For audit proofs: export CloudTrail + internal audit logs, tarball, generate sha256 manifest and cosign-sign before upload. Include a time-range manifest listing start/end timestamps and role-change ops.

security-oncall: Also ensure we revoke the KMS grant after the window and add a temporary alert suppression for `error_count > 50` during the window.

anna: Presigned link created: https://s3.presigned/redwood-pt/slot-1718009999 (expires in 2h)

marie: Final checklist: RBAC owner=josh, KMS grant=alex, scrub=samir, upload=anna, manifests=josh, alerts/security=security-oncall. Proceeding unless new blockers.

josh: No blockers after infra approval. I'll produce the role-change audit and signed manifest and upload to anna's link after the test.

marie: Thanks everyone — filing this as the handoff record and linking to the runbook. :thumbsup:
